svg.title: modupy: the same code in three shapes
svg.desc: modupy lives at github.com/jeansossmeier/modupy. Day one: the orders, payments and inventory modules run in one process, and an OrderCreated event fans out from orders to payments and inventory. When a feature gets busy: one process per module on one machine, behind a proxy on port 8000, with two inventory processes and a built-in broker carrying events between them. When a module becomes a service: modulith extract payments moves payments onto its own machine, and a Redis, database or other broker carries the same events between the app and the new service. In every shape, modulith verify keeps the modules apart and the outbox keeps their events safe.

g.text: Same modules, same events, same code: configuration picks the shape.
In every shape, modulith verify keeps the modules apart and the outbox keeps their events safe.
